{{Quote|A Je'daii needs nothing but confidence and comfort in the Force. Clothes for warmth, a ship to travel in, food for energy, water to slake thirst, a sword to stab, a blaster to shoot... all these are luxuries. The Force is everything, and without it, we are nothing.|Shall Mar|<ref name="Into the Void" />}}
'''Shall Mar''' was a [[Je'daii Master]] serving the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] circa [[28,915 BBY]]. He was known for having written the ''[[A Life in Balance]]'', a book destined to be read by generations of Je'daii that would succeed him. The text was written between [[28,930 BBY|28,930]] and [[28,918 BBY]]. In his text, Mar encouraged Je'daii to rely on their own innate talents and skills rather than calling on the Force for all their needs. While it could sustain a Je'daii, Mar postulated, it was but one tool in their arsenal. Additionally, in regard to Tython and the path of a Je'daii, Mar warned that they most know their limits and understand that not all hidden spaces should be sought out. The copy of "A Life in Balance" owned by [[Lanoree Brock's father]] was produced with great care.<ref name="Into the Void" />
